text.text: Your eye care practice in one place. Start with Exams for today, call patients under Patients whose recall is due, and keep Optical orders moving. Operational tracking only; exam records and prescriptions stay in your clinical system.
Most exams are repeat exams. A steady recall routine fills the schedule.
Open Patients and use the Next 30 days view of Recall due.
Call or text each patient and offer two times.
Book the exam and set status to Current once it is done.
Leave the patient as Recall due, then Lapsed after six months.
Note the exam allowance and frame allowance on the exam.
Tell the patient what to expect to pay at check-in.
Offer a self-pay estimate and let the patient decide before the exam.
Press Start optical order on the patient.
Pick a frame from Frames and confirm the price.
Collect the deposit and set a Promised by date.
Press Sent to lab when the order leaves.
Press Ready for pickup when it arrives and notify the patient.
Overdue orders appear under Overdue on the Optical orders table.
Update On hand for sold and received frames
Review anything marked Reorder under Stock check
Rotate slow styles to the front
